lines.t: The heart of a child is meek and mild,
They come running to the Lord when He calls.
God’s precious sheep,
Each one He will keep,
Hidden away in His stall.
And the Lord will protect all those that are His;
No danger will harm them at all.
Little fireflies who light up the sky,
And are guided to know where to go.
By His loving hand He gives His command,
And His fireflies put on a show.
They sing to the Lord in one accord,
And the beautiful music starts to grow.
His praises resound in the sky,
And these little ones sing to their beloved King:
And these little ones sing to their beloved King:
Praise Yahushua, our Adonai.
They’re like flowers; He waters them well,
And He smiles at them all with delight.
For a moment they’re ours,
These precious flowers,
So mothers, please raise them just right.
And they’re here today,
But could be gone tomorrow;
Parents, don’t cry—they’re all right.
